product_metadata.title: Tree of Life Tapestry Cotton Bedspread 108" x 88" Full-Queen Beige
description: TREE OF LIFE TAPESTRY ~ Beautiful tree of life tapestry in a lovely shade of cream with accenting colors of crimson red, emerald green and gold. Measuring approximately 88 x 108 inches and made of 100% hand-woven cotton. They are color fast and can be machine washed on cool/gentle and tumble dried. The Tree of Life is very distinct in that is represents one of the oldest spiritual symbols known to man. It represents connection of Heaven and Earth, Body and Soul. It symbolizes the oneness of us all to the oneness of creation. The complete circle of Life. References to the "Tree of Life" that link mankind to heavenly worlds have been found in ancient cultures spanning from Europe to the Orient throughout history. A nice quality light to mid weight material with endless versatility. They can be used for: ~FURNITURE COVER~BEDSPREAD~ ~TABLECLOTH~BEACH BLANKET~ ~ROOM DIVIDER~A GREAT AFFORDABLE GIFT~ ~HANG THEM ON YOUR WALL OR CEILING~! We hope to inspire your imagination & creativity~:-)
